Looks Like This Male Cop Just Got Busted Searching His Female Cop Partner's Vagina For An Illegal Orgasm
An unusual moment of intimacy in the middle of a public street was witnessed by a pair of police officers in Mexico City .
An official and a female official were recorded in what was clearly an act of sex the front seats of their own patrol car.
According to the video that went viral on social media, the incident occurred in broad daylight, inside a police vehicle parked on a street.
They didn't even bother to close the window and made little effort to be quiet.
Following the viralization of the footage, the Mexico City Secretariat of Citizen Security issued a public statement confirming the authenticity of the images. It confirmed that the perpetrators had been identified.
“Personnel from the General Directorate of Internal Affairs of this Secretariat took note and initiated the internal administrative investigation file;The two police officers have already been identified and will be summoned to give their statement.", the institution indicated.
"The Secretariat of Citizen Security reiterates that it will not tolerate any act contrary to police protocols or the principles that govern us as an institution. All cases that violate these regulations will be investigated and punished," he stated.
